title: Executor result
description: The outcome of one executor run, written to the factory-named GNOMISH_RESULT_FILE and read through the one capped result reader; stdout and stderr are logs, never this document. Readers ignore unknown properties (additive evolution, protocol version 1). Implements FR1, FR2, FR6 of define-executor-contract.

status.description: The closed status taxonomy. Unknown-token arm: any other token is read as failed/infrastructure with a reason naming the token.

failureClass.description: Required when status is failed. quality burns an attempt; infrastructure burns none and escalates after retries; limit burns none and ends the stage with a budget-exhausted escalation. Unknown-token arm: read as infrastructure, naming the token.

pendingKey.description: Required when status is pending: the opaque key the factory polls with, handed to the poll in GNOMISH_PENDING_KEY, so at most 4096 characters and no control character; any other key reads as failed/infrastructure. A pending result from a role whose caller cannot poll is failed/infrastructure.

reason.description: Optional free text explaining the status; untrusted text.

denials.description: The denials the run met (egress and policy refusals); absent means none.

usage.description: What the run consumed, as the executor reports it. ABSENT never renders as zero: an executor that cannot report usage says so. The factory adds role, executor name and vote index when it records the entry.

provenance.description: Unknown-token arm: read as ABSENT, never as zero usage.

models.description: Per resolved model id: the four token counts and an optional cost in USD.
